g9_hero_subtitle: The Ultimate Intelligent SUV. Designed for your journey.
hero_feature_desc: Watch the G9 in motion and see its design from every angle.
g9_aero_desc2: The Apex G9 achieves a drag coefficient of just 0.235Cd, enabling superior efficiency without compromising on the expansive utility required for your next adventure.
g9_awd_desc1: Equipped with a dual motor all wheel drive system and Brembo high performance braking.
g9_awd_desc2: Command the road with intelligent all wheel drive. Powered by high performance dual motors, the Apex G9 monitors road conditions in milliseconds, delivering precision torque to every wheel for maximum grip in any environment.
g9_cabin_desc2: Experience a cockpit that anticipates your needs, featuring premium materials and an immersive surround sound system. Every detail is meticulously crafted to ensure your journey is as comfortable as it is connected.
tech_subtitle: Engineered without compromise. Pure electric power meets surgical precision handling.
exclusive_subtitle: Exclusive benefits designed for the early pioneers of the G9 vision.
card_expo_desc: Experience the pinnacle of our G9 debut series with exclusive trims and performance upgrades.
card_gala_desc: Unlock premium savings on weekly and weekend rentals of the G9.
card_seminar_desc: Seamless, rapid charging access for your G9 rental at partner stations nationwide.
journey_subtitle: Experience the fusion of elegance and intelligence firsthand at your nearest experience center.
footer_desc: Defining the future of electric mobility through precision engineering and avant-garde design. Join us in the journey towards sustainable luxury.
